item.title: Building South Africa’s skilled workforce for a competitive industrial future
item.description: The merSETA remains focused on building a workforce that is skilled, adaptable and ready for the future of manufacturing and engineering in South Africa. Each year, thousands of learners participate in occupational programmes in priority areas such as welding, toolmaking, automotive diagnostics, mechatronics and polymer processing.

item.title: Global Agri Traders
item.description: Global Agri Traders aim to breed and produce to supply local and international markets with high quality agricultural products that include cattle, livestock, embryos, lucerne and other agricultural products.

item.title: Opportunity for equity investment in Namakwa Irrigation Project
item.description: The anchor project is currently being developed and stakeholders include the IDC and Raisins SA. Bankable business plans and feasibility studies have been conducted. The project seeks equity investors.

item.title: Mayibuye Precinct seeks investors for tourism development
item.description: The Mayibuye Precinct is rich in history, having being established soon after the De Beers Mine opened in 1886. Situated in one of the first townships in Kimberley, it has great potential to be developed as a tourism attraction.

item.title: Seeking funding partners for fresh produce market recapitalization
item.description: This initiative presents a strategic investment opportunity in agribusiness infrastructure, logistics and market efficiency.

item.title: Spotlight on Africa’s Renewables Boom
item.description: The 18th Africa Energy Indaba, the continent's premier energy event, will convene from 3–5 March 2026 at the Cape Town International Convention Centre (CTICC).

item.title: Durban addresses bottlenecks hindering development
item.description: The initiative forms part of the city’s ongoing commitment to engage directly with investors and developers to resolve challenges impacting catalytic projects.

item.title: A strategically positioned investment destination in southern Africa
item.description: Opportunities exist in key sectors of this region and its strategic location at the confluence of major logistics arterials and corridors such as the R30, N1, N6, N5, N8 and N3, makes the transportation of goods economically viable.

item.title: Gauteng Investment Conference 2026
item.description: Get ready for the Gauteng Investment Conference, where ideas meet opportunity, investment drives growth, and partnerships shape the future of Gauteng's economy.

item.title: 5th Annual Women & Leadership in Engineering, Infrastructure and Innovation
item.description: Invest in STEM leadership: The 5th Annual Women & Leadership in Engineering, Infrastructure and Innovation will take place on 11-12 March at the Indaba Hotel, Johannesburg. Early registration discounts before 18 February.
